| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where csMethod == "POST"
| where csUriStem contains "login-with-passkey" or csUriQuery contains "login-with-passkey"
| where scStatus in (200, 302)          // Craft returns 200 (AJAX) / 302 on a completed passkey login
| summarize Attempts = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Statuses = make_set(scStatus), UserAgents = make_set(csUserAgent), Hosts = make_set(Computer) by cIP, csUriStem, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where Attempts >= 2                    // 2 = a real ceremony is a single successful POST; repeats = replayed assertion body
| extend WindowSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by Attempts desc

description: Detects the unshare -Urn invocation used by the OVSwrap PoC to gain CAP_NET_ADMIN in a private user+network namespace
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/new-ovswrap-linux-kernel-flaw-lets.html
  - https://blog.cloudlinux.com/ovswrap-cve-2026-64531-mitigation/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/05
tags:
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.privilege_escalation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/unshare'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-Urn'
      - '-rUn'
  selection_longflags:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--user'
      - '--net'
  filter_root:
    User: 'root'
  condition: selection_img and (selection_flags or selection_longflags) and not filter_root
level: medium
2684.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=unshare (Processes.process="*-Urn*" OR Processes.process="*- Urn*" OR (Processes.process="*--user*" AND Processes.process="*--net*" AND (Processes.process="*--map-root-user*" OR Processes.process="* -r *"))) Processes.user!=root by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2684.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/unshare$/i
| regex("(-Urn|-rUn|--user.*--net)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=root
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine], function=count())
